name: Sara Balloo
summary: In Ironforge's Military Ward, Sara Balloo mourns her husband Sully and holds fast to the words he left behind.

sections.title: A Widow's Vigil
sections.body: Sara Balloo keeps vigil in Ironforge's Military Ward, amid the clang of weapons and the drill of soldiers. Her husband, Sully Balloo, fell in battle far from home, leaving her alone with grief and memories. A final letter, carried across the mountains from where he died, gives Sara words from his last days and a measure of closure.

sections.title: A Cry for Remembrance
sections.body: Sara Balloo wants Sully's sacrifice remembered. In her appeals, she asks King Magni Bronzebeard to honor Sully and other fallen soldiers from the throne, so the cost borne by ordinary dwarven families is not forgotten.

faq.answer: Sara Balloo lives in Ironforge's Military Ward. She is the widow of Sully Balloo, a dwarven soldier who fell in battle.

faq.q: Where can I find Sara Balloo?
faq.answer: You can find Sara Balloo in Ironforge's Military Ward, near the training grounds and barracks.
Sully Balloo died during military service. His belongings and a final waterlogged letter were lost until an adventurer recovered them.

faq.q: What does Sara do with Sully's letter?
faq.answer: After reading Sully's heartfelt words, Sara writes to King Magni Bronzebeard, asking him to recognize and remember Sully's sacrifice.

angles.text: As a dwarf passing through Ironforge's Military Ward, you can see in Sara Balloo the toll on families whose kin defend Khaz Modan.
As an Alliance soldier, you see how news can bring closure to a fallen soldier's family, and how battles across Azeroth wound those at home.
